# Wyrd — full machine-readable reference

Generated from `crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/`. `architecture/wyrd-design.md` is the design authority; this schema dump may include implementation drift while `wyrd-spec` is reconciled.

## AgentCard

Declare an agent that Wyrd can describe, govern, evaluate, install references for, and observe. Execution stays in the user or framework runtime.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/agent/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/agent_spec.json

## ArtifactCard

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/artifact/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/artifact_spec.json

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
```

## DataCard

Describe a dataset, feature table, document set, or other data dependency.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/data/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/data_spec.json

## ExperimentCard

Group work-in-progress runs and candidate changes under a single intent.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/experiment/
Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/experiment_spec.json

## WorkflowCard

Describe a coordinated sequence of operators, tools, agents, or services.

Schema source: crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/workflow_spec.json

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "definitions": {
    "AgentRef": {
      "anyOf": [
        {

            {

            {
              "$ref": "#/definitions/CardRef"

        }
      ],
      "description": "Reference to a workflow step's agent, either inline or by Agent Card reference."
    },
    "AgentRunConfigSpec": {
      "description": "Pure-serde mirror of the Skald agent run configuration.",
      "properties": {
        "max_iterations": {
          "description": "Maximum loop iterations before the agent stops.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0.0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "session_recent_limit": {
          "description": "Maximum recent session turns loaded at run start.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0.0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "timeout_ms": {
          "description": "Overall agent run timeout in milliseconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0.0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "tool_concurrency_cap": {
          "description": "Maximum concurrent runtime-local tool calls per model iteration.",
```

## SourceCard

Declare where Wyrd reads external observations, archived runs, or object-store evidence.

URL: https://wyrd.ai/cards/source/
SourceSpec is design-authoritative in architecture/wyrd-design.md and pending in wyrd-spec.
